intro_html: Dump-and-go chili that does all the work while you go live your life. Each bowl brings 54 grams of protein for about $5.27 a serving (at everyday cost). It makes 14 servings, so your crock pot is basically running a meal-prep shop.
cost_closing_html: About $5.27 a bowl (at everyday cost) for a high-protein dinner that beats takeout on price and macros.
portion_html: Each of the 14 bowls gives you 54 grams of protein and about 568 calories.
upsell_html: Set it in the morning, come home to dinner, and stash the rest for the week ahead. Members get every recipe in the Meal Prep section, plus the full library of money lessons and tools, all for $1 a month.
shop_smart: Grab the 7 lb ground turkey pack at around $4.55 a pound. It is cheaper than beef and carries this whole pot.
A little can of chipotle in adobo adds big smoky flavor for about a buck, so do not skip it.
Buy your beans and tomatoes as store-brand cans and let the pantry staples keep the cost down.
make_it: Add the raw ground turkey to the slow cooker and break it up with a spoon.
Dump in the black beans, diced tomatoes, tomato paste, chopped onion, and bell peppers.
Stir in the chili powder and the chopped chipotle in adobo for a little smoky heat.
Cover and cook on low for 6 to 8 hours, giving it one stir partway through if you are around.
Break up any big pieces of turkey, then serve it over or alongside more beans.

head.description: A high-protein Tex-Mex meal prep. Fourteen servings at about 568 calories and 54 grams of protein for roughly $5.27 each (at everyday cost).
